properties.english_form: The base address of the vector table is initialized to the boot address (must be aligned to 256 bytes, i.e., its least significant byte must be 0x00) when the core is booting.
To allow higher priority interrupts only, the handler must configure ``mie`` accordingly.
In configurations where ``SecureIbex == 0`` it must exist but can be implemented as a straight passthrough.
Ibex uses a `custom fork of FuseSoC <https://github.com/lowRISC/fusesoc/tree/ot>`_, so you must install it via this method rather than installing FuseSoC separately.
In particular, to enable/disable ``mcycle(h)``, bit 0 must be written. For ``minstret(h)``, it is bit 2. For event counter ``mhpmcounterX(h)``, it is bit X.
The request coming from the instruction fetch unit are not gated by the PMP check, so integrators must choose carefully what to connect to the instruction fetch bus.
In addition, a technology-specific clock gating cell must be provided to keep the clock inactive when the latches are not written.
This cell must be wrapped in a module called ``prim_clock_gating``.
Spike must be built with the ``--enable-commitlog`` and ``--enable-misaligned`` options.
